nodes.prompt:
TASK: Review the Tauri Rust backend codebase in src-tauri/ for architectural soundness, concurrency safety, IPC reliability, resource lifecycle management, and performance.
DELIVERABLE: A detailed markdown review report covering:
1. Architecture & Module Structure (src-tauri/src/lib.rs, daemon/, terminal/, browser/, worktree/, remote/, notification/, ipc/)
2. Rust Idioms & Safety (error handling with anyhow/thiserror, unsafe usage if any, concurrency with tokio/parking_lot/std::sync, mutex deadlock risks)
3. Terminal PTY & Daemon Protocol (pty management, buffer pooling, output hub, daemon socket communication, session persistence)
4. IPC Command Design (serialization, payload bounds, async command cancellation, error propagation to frontend)
5. Concrete code citations with file:line numbers, categorized issues (Critical / Warning / Optimization / Nit), and suggested improvements.
SCOPE: Read files under src-tauri/ (especially src-tauri/src/ and src-tauri/Cargo.toml). Read-only.
VERIFY: Ensure all referenced files and line numbers exist and accurately reflect current code in src-tauri/.
STOP WHEN: The complete Rust backend review report with concrete file:line citations is written and returned in the output.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Review all UI components, user experience patterns, drag-and-drop mechanics, layout styling, and Ferryx branding compliance in ui/src/components/ and styles.
DELIVERABLE: A detailed markdown review report covering:
1. Component Architecture & Hierarchy (ui/src/components/TabBar.tsx, TerminalSplitView.tsx, BrowserPane.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, CommandPalette.tsx, ProjectDialogs.tsx, tab-dnd/)
2. Drag and Drop UX & Split Resizing (tab-dnd drop zones, pane drag handles, split separator visibility, resize hit areas, drop target fallbacks)
3. CSS / Theming / Styling Health (ui/src/index.css, settings-runtime.css, Tailwind usage, theme token propagation, dark/light contrast, active tab accent styling)
4. Ferryx Brand & Asset Compliance (verification of Ferryx naming vs legacy Orca branding, icon integrity, asset cleanups)
5. Accessibility & UX edge cases (keyboard navigation, focus traps, screen reader readiness, mobile key dock, overflow clipping)

VERIFY: Ensure all referenced components, CSS classes, and lines accurately match ui/src/.
STOP WHEN: The complete UI/UX and styling review report is returned.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Review security posture, process isolation, remote pairing authentication, input validation, and end-to-end error handling across backend and frontend.
DELIVERABLE: A detailed markdown review report covering:
1. Security Boundaries & Process Spawning (command execution in src-tauri/src/terminal/pty.rs, daemon/server.rs, environment sanitization, path traversal risks)
2. Remote Protocol & Pairing Security (src-tauri/src/remote/auth.rs, tailscale.rs, server.rs, pairing token generation, cryptographic validation, TLS/WSS usage)
3. Webview & Browser Security (src-tauri/src/browser/security.rs, cookies.rs, manager.rs, navigation restrictions, CSP, sandbox boundaries)
4. IPC Validation & Error Contracts (src-tauri/src/ipc/error.rs, ui/src/lib/ipcErrors.ts, payload size limits, untrusted input handling)
5. Client-side Error Boundaries & Recovery (unhandled promise rejections, terminal crash recovery, daemon disconnect handling)
6. Concrete file:line citations, security severity ratings (High / Medium / Low / Best Practice), and mitigation code examples.
SCOPE: Read files under src-tauri/src/ and ui/src/lib/. Read-only.
VERIFY: Check all cited paths and logic against current implementation.
STOP WHEN: The complete security and error handling review report is returned.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Synthesize the comprehensive review findings from all 5 domain review nodes into an authoritative, structured, highly readable Code Review & Architecture Audit document, and persist it to docs/code-review-report.md.
DELIVERABLE: A comprehensive, professional markdown document written to docs/code-review-report.md containing:
1. Executive Summary & Health Scorecard (Architecture, Code Quality, Security, UI/UX, Testing)
2. Architecture Overview & High-Level System Design (Tauri + Rust daemon/pty + React/TS frontend + remote transport)
3. In-Depth Domain Analyses (Backend, Frontend State/Terminal, UI/UX Components, Security & IPC, Testing & Tooling)
4. Prioritized Issues Matrix (Severity: Critical, High, Medium, Low, Nit; Category, Impact, Exact file:line citations, Concrete Fix Recommendations)
5. Architectural Strengths & Well-Designed Patterns in Ferryx (Orca-lite)
6. Actionable Step-by-Step Modernization & Hardening Roadmap
SCOPE: Read domain review outputs from upstream nodes; read codebase files for additional context if needed; write docs/code-review-report.md.
VERIFY: Verify docs/code-review-report.md is created, non-empty (>500 lines of thorough review), well-formatted markdown with valid file:line references.
STOP WHEN: docs/code-review-report.md is successfully written to disk and verified.
